newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Anglo Irish Bank says outlook for '97 good.
newsitem.headline: Anglo Irish Bank says outlook for '97 good.

text.p: Anglo Irish Bankcorp Plc said on Friday that it had doubled in size during the past three years and that the outlook for the current year was "extremely good".
"Looking forward, I am confident of another good out-turn in 1997," chairman Gerry Murphy told the group's annual meeting.
"Profits are well ahead of the corresponding period last year. All sectors are ahead of target so I am optimistic that we will continue to build on the strong performance of 1996," he said.
The bank reported a 26 percent rise in profits to 24.1 million Irish pounds last year.
